svg.text: 60 breakthroughs under eight factors, plus the Contact Clause beside the equation. Each box shows the chance the node resolves before 2071 / 2095 / ever, given what it depends on. Arrows run from a dependency to the node that needs it.
First-pass numbers, under review by outside models before publication (roadmap step 27); every number may move.
Headline, A2 (works off earth on rotation): baseline 0.9% · moderate 2.2% · strong 5.6% · radical 14% · open 18%
T3 (Slow Expanse, the bar for the Belt existing): baseline 1.6% · moderate 3.6% · strong 8.9% · radical 23% · open 30%

Scenarios are the year the window closes: baseline 2071, moderate 2080, strong 2095, radical 2136, open = no deadline. Computed from 20,000 play-throughs per scenario with the world draw at its default spread.
Leaves: could resolve within five years
Dashed outline: a choice John makes, never rolled. Filled: already resolved.
